## If this pull request adds a technique to `matrix.json`

The pull request that adds a technique to `matrix.json` carries, **in the same commit**, both
placements (CONTRIBUTING.md, "Placing a new technique"):

- [ ] its `canonical-classes.json` `primary` class
- [ ] its placement in `cross-references/`: either **(A)** named against an OWASP item in
      `owasp-llm-mapping.md`, or **(B)** listed with no counterpart in
      `technique-overlap-index.md`

A PR that adds a technique without both is incomplete, and both validators failing is the gate
working as designed. If this PR adds no technique, delete this section.
